d: JASARA PMC is on the lookout for a skilled and innovative Design Manager to become an integral part of our dynamic team. As the Design Manager, you will take charge of the design process for various projects, ensuring that the creative vision aligns seamlessly with client requirements and industry standards. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to develop design solutions that are not only functional but also visually compelling.

Your role will involve guiding and mentoring the design team, overseeing project timelines, and ensuring that designs are executed accurately and efficiently. Your creativity, technical skills, and leadership capabilities will play a key role in driving project success and client satisfaction.
q: Bachelor's degree in Architecture or a related field
A minimum of 15 years of experience in design management of commercial & residential buildings, Mixed-Use land development project
Proficient in design software such as AutoCAD, BIM, Revit, and Adobe Creative Suite
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively
Strong leadership and team collaboration skills
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
A keen eye for detail and a strong aesthetic sensibility
Experience in various types of projects, including commercial, residential, or hospitality, is preferred
r: Lead and manage the design team from concept through to completion of projects
Collaborate with clients and various stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into innovative design solutions
Review and approve design drawings and specifications to ensure they meet project requirements
Conduct design presentations and design reviews with clients to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments
Ensure that all designs comply with industry standards, codes, and regulations
Coordinate with other departments, such as construction and project management, to ensure cohesive project delivery
Monitor project progress and address any issues that arise throughout the design and execution phases
Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies to inspire and guide the design team
If you are a passionate and forward-thinking design professional looking to make a significant impact in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply.
x: Opportunity to work in a dynamic and growing organization
Be part of a collaborative and supportive team
